entities.name: Johann Baptist Moroder
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johann Baptist Moroder was an Austrian sculptor. He mainly focused on sculptures of bigger sizes representing Christian sacred figures; nowadays his works are mainly spread in the Italian region of Alto Adige.
